usedFor: CallRail tracks calls and texts, and Memory stores values as key-value pairs when “Text Message Received” runs “Memory”.

bestTemplate.name: “Text Message Received” in CallRail, then “Memory” in Memory
bestTemplate.why: Each inbound text can be saved under a key, so later steps can look it up.

watchOut: “Outbound Call Modified” fires on every change to a call, so one call can write to “Memory” repeatedly.
